feature: ADR-0093 independent owned Linux reload pipes and guarded inheritance/claim

linux.new_actual_main_harness: two owned child modes: reload/legacy absent; passed, not included in libtest count

abi: New narrow unsafe uses existing fcntl commands/flags only, pipe admission reuses audited fstat; existing C oracle rerun. No external dependencies or lock changes.

windows.scope: Linux-only cfg endpoint; prior shared/native checks still pending automatic approval quota issue

limitations: Actual worker main and host still use old spawn; no active reload/actor/lease/pump integration, watcher or CLI.
Trusted caller must not change shared O_NONBLOCK/direction, duplicate competing consumers, or rebind selected descriptors; no endpoint authentication/atomic metadata proof.
Copies CLOEXEC, original inherited selected FD retained until actual exit; physical EOF not guaranteed by logical copy drop.
Harness only owned child/pipes/sealed memfd and metadata; no input/VT/uinput/Windows global API, suspend or driver.
Harness sends only Rejected at base=1 with epoch0, no fake actor/Accepted/recovery report.
Actual exit may be code0 or supervisor-owned SIGKILL on channel EOF race; this is not a cooperative recovery proof.
Five-second observation polls same child/transaction; no restart. Transport fixture does not concurrently drive progress pump/parent lease.
Full original cross-platform objective remains unfinished.
